findings.title: Refund job writes invoices directly, skipping billing's tax rules
findings.scenario: Refund flow (core): every refund issued by support
findings.blast_radius: invoices table; 2 writers in 2 deployable units
findings.trace: 1. worker/refunds/job.py:58 updates invoices.total directly. 2. api/billing/service.py:120 recomputes tax on every invoice change. 3. The job never calls it
findings.impact: Expected (R-01): every invoice change goes through billing. Actual: refunded invoices keep the pre-refund tax amount
findings.fix: Call BillingService.adjust() from the refund job instead of updating the table
findings.guard: R-01: CI search fails on writes to invoices outside api/billing/

validation.evidence: job.py:58 raw UPDATE; no call to billing in worker/refunds/

findings.title: Shipment consumer is not idempotent on redelivery
findings.scenario: Order shipping (core): one message per shipped parcel
findings.trace: 1. The consumer decrements stock per message. 2. It does not use the dedup helper at worker/consumers/base.py:20. 3. A redelivered message decrements again
findings.impact: Expected (R-03): one effect per message. Actual: stock drifts low on every redelivery, if the broker delivers at least once
findings.fix: Use the dedup helper keyed on the message ID, in the same transaction as the decrement
findings.guard: R-03: test delivers the same shipment message twice and asserts one decrement

validation.evidence: shipment.py:31 has no dedup; broker delivery semantics not in the repository

findings.title: Pricing domain imports the ORM session
findings.scenario: Changing discount rules (changed 4 times in 12 months)
findings.trace: 1. discounts.py:3 imports db.session. 2. Discount rules query coupons inside the domain function
findings.impact: Expected (R-02): domain code is persistence-free. Actual: discount rules can only be tested with a database
findings.fix: Pass a coupon repository into the discount function
findings.guard: R-02: add api.pricing.domain to the import-linter layers contract
